The '''Chroma Zed system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] portion<ref name="aoc-map" /> of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] region called [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]],<ref name="slice" /> within the [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian sector]].<ref name="aoc-map" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] ran [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] operations in the system during its reign.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
